info.title: Yousra Stock API
info.description:
Internal ERP/stock management API for Yousra Company.

**Response envelope**
- Single resource: `{ "data": { ... } }`
- List: `{ "data": [ ... ], "meta": { "page", "pageSize", "total" } }`
- Error: `{ "error": { "message": string, "code": string } }`

apiTokenAuth.name: X-Api-Token
apiTokenAuth.description: Opaque token issued when an external system is registered. Service-to-service only.

code.description: Short handle external systems use to address this warehouse (unique per company).

reference.description: Human-readable document number. Null only on rows created before this field existed.

invoiceNumber.description: Human-readable invoice number. Rows created before this format shipped keep their legacy `INV-<uuid>` value.

reference.description: Human-readable document number. Null only on rows created before this field existed.
Human-readable document number. Null only on rows created before this field existed.

quantity.description: Always positive — direction is implied by `type`.

createdBy.description: Set for human-initiated movements; null when an external system initiated it.

createdByExternalSystemId.description: Set for SALE / RETURN movements from an external system.

externalRef.description: The originating external order's reference. Set only on SALE / RETURN.

IssuedCredentials.description: The plaintext `apiToken` is returned only here — never stored hashed, never returned again by list/get.

code.description: Machine-readable code: NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_ERROR, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, CONFLICT, INTERNAL_ERROR.

post.description: `companyId` is taken from the authenticated user — not accepted in the body.

get.summary: Get the current stock level for one item in one warehouse
get.description: A pair with no movements yet returns quantity "0", not a 404.

post.summary: Record a manual stock movement (CONSUMPTION, MANUAL_OUT, or ADJUSTMENT)
post.description: Body shape depends on `type`. ADJUSTMENT takes `direction` (increase|decrease) — use it to set a new item's opening quantity or correct a count. MANUAL_OUT takes `reason`. CONSUMPTION takes `nomenclatureId`. STOCK_IN / TRANSFER_* are not reachable here.

get.summary: Get a stock movement by id

post.description: `createdBy` is derived from the authenticated user.

get.summary: List invoices (read-only — always auto-generated by a goods receipt)

post.summary: Record a goods receipt against a purchase order
post.description: Increments stock levels, appends STOCK_IN stock movements, generates an invoice, and rolls the parent purchase order's status forward. `supplierId` / `warehouseId` are derived from the purchase order.

get.summary: Get a goods receipt (with items + invoice)

post.summary: Create a new (draft) BOM version for an item
post.description: Changing a recipe means a new version — there is no lines-edit endpoint. Activate it via POST /nomenclature/{id}/activate.

get.summary: List BOM versions, optionally filtered by itemId

patch.summary: Update notes on a BOM version (notes only — lines are immutable)

post.summary: Promote this version to active, demoting the previous active version

get.summary: Convert a quantity between two units of the same family

delete.description: Stamps `deletedAt` so the unit drops out of every list/get. Fails with 409 if any non-deleted item or nomenclature line still references the unit.

post.summary: Register an external system, issuing an API token (shown once)
Rotate the API token for an external system (shown once)

get.summary: Current stock for a set of items at one location (batch)
get.description: `companyId` is derived from the API token. `itemIds` are Yousra Item UUIDs; an item with no movements yet reports quantity `"0"`.

parameters.name: system
parameters.description: Caller's registered name; must match the token.

post.summary: An external order was confirmed — decrement stock (one SALE movement per line)
post.description: Idempotent on `orderRef`: a repeat returns the original movements with status 200 and moves no stock. Insufficient stock for any line rolls the whole call back with a 409. Movements are attributed to the calling external system, not a user.

post.summary: A previously-consumed external order was cancelled — restore its stock
post.description: Reverses every SALE movement recorded for `orderRef` with a matching RETURN movement. Idempotent: a repeat returns the original RETURNs with status 200. 404 if no consumption was ever recorded for the order.

post.summary: Create a company and its first (Admin) user

get.summary: Get the caller's own company (returned as a single-item list — there is no cross-tenant listing)
Get a company by id (must be the caller's own company)

403.description: Forbidden — not the caller's own company
Forbidden — not the caller's own company

post.summary: Add a teammate to the caller's own company (Admin-only)
Log in with email + password, receive a JWT
